verdict.rationale: Terraform ships an official MCP server that gives external AI models real-time access to provider docs, modules and policies, and HashiCorp says it enables more accurate Terraform configuration generation. However, this only feeds third-party AI assistants. Nothing shows a built-in natural-language-to-HCL generator in the CLI or toolchain itself. Missing for 10: native NL-to-code generation inside the Terraform CLI or HCP toolchain, documented generation workflow and examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of generation quality.
